scientific_integrity: Exact cubic edge-count argument and two explicitly specified exhaustive finite graph computations; all unordered configuration pairs and symmetry actions checked. No unproved infinite extrapolation.
scientific_limitations: The specific classification concerns the 14-vertex Heawood graph only.
A 1993 framed-tree paper and a 2022 cubic cyclic-connectivity paper were accessible only at abstract level; prior equivalent computation cannot be excluded.
Independent external audit has not been performed.
title: Complementary induced-tree bisections and antipodal connected-decycling exchanges of the Heawood graph
